member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Register(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.RegisterRequest)
member.summary: Create a new account as either an Organiser or a Participant.
member.remarks: Expects first name, last name, email, password (min 8 characters), role ("Organiser" or "Participant"), and optionally phone number and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD). The password is hashed before it is stored.

member.remarks: On success a session cookie is issued. The browser (and Swagger UI) sends it automatically on later requests, which keeps the user's identity and role for the whole session.
member.returns: 200 with the session lifetime and user details, 401 for wrong email or password.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.AuthController.Logout
member.summary: End the current session.
member.returns: 204 when logged out, 401 if there was no session.

member.name: T:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController
member.summary: Participants enter event categories. Organisers view and manage the enrolments for their events.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EnrolmentsController.CreateEnrolment(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.CreateEnrolmentRequest)
member.summary: Enter an event category as the logged-in Participant.
member.remarks: Expects categoryId and optional notes. The system records the link between the participant, the event (through the category) and the selected category. The event must be Published, the category and event must not be full, and your age (from your profile date of birth) must fit the category's age limits. If you previously cancelled this enrolment it is re-activated.
member.returns: 201 with the enrolment, 400 if the event is not open or the age does not fit, 403 for Organisers, 404 if the category does not exist, 409 if already enrolled or full.

member.returns: 200 with an array of events, 401 if not logged in, 403 for Participants.

member.name: M:RaceDay.Api.Controllers.EventsController.CreateEvent(RaceDay.Api.Dtos.CreateEventRequest)
member.summary: Create a new event (Organisers only). The logged-in Organiser becomes its owner.
member.remarks: Expects title, eventDate (YYYY-MM-DD), location, city and province. member.remarks: Send the image as multipart/form-data in a field called "file" (JPG, PNG or WebP, max 5 MB). The image is stored in Azure Blob Storage and the event's imageUrl is set to the path that serves it.

member.summary: Capture the result of an enrolment (Organiser of the event only).
member.remarks: Expects enrolmentId and status ("Finished", "DNF", "DNS" or "DQ"). A "Finished" result needs finishTime (HH:mm:ss). Optional: overallPosition, categoryPosition, chipTime, gunTime. There can only be one result per enrolment. A finished result marks the enrolment as Completed.

member.returns: 200 with an array of results, 401 if not logged in, 403 for Organisers.

member.summary: The results list for an event, best position first.
member.remarks: Everyone can see the results once the Organiser has published them (the event status is "Completed"). Before that, only the Organiser who owns the event can see them.
member.returns: 200 with an ordered array of results, 404 if the event does not exist or its results are not published yet.
